description: Step into freshness with bright Ginger and Lemon notes. This Woody Aromatic scent is a reliable choice for the office. It delivers clean, spicy energy throughout the day.

name: FERRARI BLACK EDT 125 ML TESTER
description: Ferrari Black is a dynamic aromatic fougere fragrance that brings a sporty yet sophisticated edge to men's perfumery. Crisp top notes of apple and lime spice up a heart of cinnamon and cardamom, finishing with a smooth vanilla and cedar base. Ideal for casual outings and nights out, it offers a confident and approachable masculine scent.

description: FERRARI FERRARI RED is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

name: FERRARI RED POWER EDT
description: Ferrari Red Power is a dynamic aromatic fougere fragrance that channels the intense passion and high-performance energy of Italian racing. A zesty, spicy opening of blood orange and pink pepper revs up a sporty heart, finishing with a smoothly masculine tonka and cedar base. Stay invigorated, highly energized, and effortlessly cool throughout your casual daytime activities.
topNotes: Bergamot, Blood Orange, Lavender, Pink Pepper

name: FERRARI SCUDERIA BLACK EDT
description: Ferrari Scuderia Black is a highly popular, sweet, and energetic aromatic fougere fragrance that offers great versatility and appeal. Blending crisp apple, warm cinnamon, and comforting vanilla, it caters to young, active men looking for an affordable and attractive daily scent. Highly approachable and mass-pleasing, it is an excellent go-to choice for school, casual weekends, and everyday wear.

name: FIDJI EDT 100 ML UNISEX
description: Fidji by Guy Laroche is a timeless floral green fragrance that perfectly captures the essence of a distant, tropical paradise. It intricately weaves sharp, green galbanum with lush, exotic florals and a warm, woody base. This elegant and exotic classic is highly recommended for those who appreciate sophisticated and vintage-style floral compositions.

name: FIORI EDP
description: JACQUES BATTINI FIORI is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

name: FIORI EDP POUR FEMME TESTER
description: Al Shaya Fiori is a delightful and uplifting floral fruity fragrance that captures the essence of a blooming spring garden. Overflowing with bright fruits, sweet jasmine, and a soft musky dry-down, it is targeted at women seeking a cheerful, everyday scent. Light and charming, it is perfect for daytime outings, brunches, and casual wear during the warmer months.

name: FIRE NIGHT EDP
description: Fragrance Fire Night is an intensely bold and captivating perfume that ignites with a burst of warm spices and sharp citrus. A robust, masculine heart of rich leather and smoky tobacco commands attention and exudes ultimate confidence. The deep, heavy base of oud and amber makes this a powerhouse fragrance destined for unforgettable nights out in the cold.

name: FIRE YOUR DESIRE EDP
description: EMIR FIRE YOUR DESIRE is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

id: FLA FIA OUD DESIRE EDP 100N ML
name: FLA FIA OUD DESIRE EDP 100N ML
description: Command the room with Sterling Fia Oud Desire, a rich, uncompromising Middle Eastern fragrance built around the majestic, dark woods. Highlighting a classic, powerful combination of spicy saffron, deep crimson rose, and a potent, leathery oud base, it is tailored for those who project power and authority. This intensely long-lasting scent is best reserved for formal winter evenings, black-tie events, and grand celebrations.

name: FLA VIA SIGNATURE EDP
description: Make your mark with crisp Pineapple and earthy Birch. This powerful Chypre Fruity fragrance ensures impressive, enduring longevity. It excels as a versatile signature scent for both office and evening events.

name: FLAME PURE WOODS EDP
description: Maison Alhambra Flame Pure Woods is a deeply hypnotic amber woody fragrance that explores the richest, most resinous facets of nature. With an enchanting blend of earthy patchouli, sweet honey, and smoky myrrh, it is the perfect choice for lovers of intense, luxurious aromas. Wrap yourself in its comforting, powerful warmth during cold winter nights for a truly majestic aura.
baseNotes: Woody Notes, Honey, Leather, Amber, Musk, Vanilla

name: FLAUNT WOMEN EDP
description: Elsatys Flaunt is a vibrant and glamorous amber floral fragrance that truly lives up to its name, designed to turn heads. A luscious opening of peach and mandarin bursts into an opulent bouquet of white florals, rounded out by a seductive vanilla base. Perfect for date nights, this scent guarantees you will radiate confident, irresistible femininity.

name: FLAVIA LEATHER NOIR PARFUM
description: Sterling Flavia Leather Noir is a luxurious and intense leather fragrance that masterfully contrasts sweet fruit with smoky depth. Featuring prominent notes of raspberry, saffron, and rich suede leather, it appeals to daring individuals who enjoy sophisticated and niche-style aromas. This bold statement fragrance is highly recommended for cold evenings, date nights, and exclusive social events.
